## Phase 9 — PRD Fidelity

### 1-2. Spec AC → PRD AC mapping and behavioural fidelity

Every spec AC maps to at least one PRD AC. Three compound ACs were split atomically
by the planner — each half keeps the original symbol, inputs and assertion, so these
are faithful splits, not drift:

| Spec AC | PRD destination | Note |
|---|---|---|
| US-001 #2 — `estimatedCostUsd` **and** `exactCostUsd` equal the error's | US-001 #2, #3 | split, one assertion each |
| US-001 #9 — `costUsd` equals exact when carried, estimated when only that | US-001 #10, #11 | split, one branch each |
| US-004 #7 — trimmed origin URL on exit 0, `null` on non-zero | US-004 #7, #8 | split, one exit class each |

All remaining 34 spec ACs map 1:1. Full per-story counts: US-001 12 → 14,
US-002 11 → 11, US-003 6 → 6, US-004 8 → 9.

Three mappings scored below a mechanical token-overlap threshold and were resolved
by reading; all three are faithful and none is a finding:

- **US-003 spec #3 → PRD #3** — "passes the runner the same `codingToolRuntime`
  instance supplied by the caller". Same identity-preservation assertion, reworded.
- **US-004 spec #2 → PRD #2** — the spec AC is elliptical ("in that collision case"),
  which the planner resolved to "When `planCommand` encounters a
  `RUN_NAME_COLLISION` identity claim". Same assertion, better standalone wording.
- **US-004 spec #5 → PRD #5** — the planner tightened "derives `projectKey` from
  `config.name`" to "claims under the **trimmed** `config.name`". This matches the
  spec's own Design (`config.name?.trim() || basename(workdir)`), so it is a
  tightening toward the spec, not away from it.

**Signature reality check.** The PRD ACs asserting calls against existing interfaces
were diffed against real signatures: `buildDispatchErrorEvent`
(`src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:178`), `attachCostSubscriber`
(`src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts`), `CostAggregator.snapshot()`/`drain()`
(`src/runtime/cost-aggregator.ts:281`,`:382`), `pruneRetainedTranscripts`
(`src/agents/native/session/transcript-store.ts:165`), `runTrackedSession`
(`src/session/manager-run.ts:44`), `planCommand` (`src/cli/plan-command.ts:79`) and
`_planDeps.spawnSync` (`src/cli/plan-runtime.ts`). No arity or parameter-shape
contradiction found.
